title: Manage Add-ons
content:
## Manage Add-ons


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000057921

In this section, the admin can view all activated add-ons on the site, see details about each one, and find out how to get them individually if needed.

Go to Dashboard > Manage Add-Ons :


## Add-On Status


The admin can filter the results:

- Active

- Inactive


## Add-Ons Search


Or search for a specific add-on:


## Add-Ons Documentation


There is also a link to the documentation about the add-on:


## Activating Add-Ons


Already purchased Add-Ons will be available to activate in the Account Dashboard. A ny purchased Add-Ons still pending activation will be listed in this section.

The " Click to Activate + " button to assign the add-on package to one of the available Website Licenses.
